jobs.title: ICT Project Manager
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Project manager
jobs.description:
Запрошуємо Project Managers до команди нашого клієнта, молодої та амбітної української компанії, що працює у сфері MilTech та розробляє технологічні рішення для оборонного сектору. Компанія є резидентом Дія.City.
Компанія активно розвивається, масштабує діяльність та відкриває нові продуктові напрями. Відкриваємо декілька вакансій: шукаємо фахівців (Project Managers)
, які зможуть координувати повний цикл розробки нових продуктів: від ідеї та прототипу до тестування й запуску у виробництво.
Це можливість долучитися до розвитку сучасних оборонних технологій, працювати без зайвої бюрократії та будувати ефективні процеси разом із командою. На вас очікують швидкість у прийнятті рішень, гнучкість, відкрита культура партнерського спілкування та доступність керівництва. У команді всі на «ТИ»!
Ключові завдання та зони відповідальності:

Координація розробки та впровадження нових продуктів (R&D-проєкти): паралельне ведення кількох проєктів, контроль ключових етапів і дедлайнів, актуалізація статусів задач та інформування учасників про зміни.
Деталізація продуктових ідей від розробників та розподіл зон відповідальності між підрозділами й зовнішніми експертами.
Пошук підрядників із конструювання та виробництва, переговори, узгодження технічних завдань і договорів про співпрацю.
Опрацювання виробничих задач разом із конструкторами та інженерами: технічні характеристики, комплектація, функціональні можливості продукту.
Супровід та контроль виробництва, забезпечення виконання робіт безпосередньо «на місцях».
Координація закупівель і логістики компонентів та матеріалів: моніторинг ринку запчастин (наявність, вартість, аналоги), постановка задач закупівельнику, контроль термінів поставок.
Організація тестування та польових випробувань нових зразків: збір зворотного зв’язку, систематизація недоліків, передача розробникам і контроль їх усунення.
Організація та контроль підготовки технічної документації: ТУ, специфікації, паспорти виробів, інструкції; підтримка її відповідності актуальним версіям продуктів.
Передача актуальної інформації про продукт відділам продажів, маркетингу та іншим підрозділам.

Портрет кандидата:

Досвід роботи Project Manager від 3 років у розробці продуктів: IT, розробка програмного забезпечення (SaaS/продукти), апаратна розробка та виробництво. Досвід у MilTech буде перевагою.
Розуміння повного циклу виготовлення продукції: від прототипу та плати до польових випробувань і серії.
Досвід роботи з конструкторською та технічною документацією (кодифікація, подання технічних умов).
Досвід роботи з MS Project, Jira (або аналогами), Excel, Google Workspace; розуміння принципів проєктного планування.
Уміння структурувати інформацію, визначати пріоритети та контролювати виконання задач в умовах багатозадачності та змін.
Особистісно: проактивність, гнучкість мислення, швидкість у прийнятті рішень, ініціативність, чесність і відкритість.

Буде перевагою / бажано:
Досвід взаємодії з військовими або профільними експертами для швидкого збору зворотного зв’язку з фронту чи полігонів.
Навички роботи з Linux-консоллю.

Умови:

Віддалений формат роботи з проживанням в Україні (пріоритетно Дніпро, Львів або Київ)
Заробітна плата на ВТ: 80 000 — 100 000 грн.
Після ВТ: від 100 000 грн.

jobs.title: Principal Program Manager, 2 Hour Learning (Remote) - $200,000/year USD
jobs.description:
You’ve built dashboards. Tracked milestones. Chased vendors. Flagged risks. But your reports hit a ceiling. You weren’t the one making the calls.

2 Hour Learning is building an AI-powered education model designed to help students achieve a full day of academic progress in just two hours. Making that model work at scale requires dozens of initiatives, technology partners, contracts, and investment decisions to move in sync. Your job is to make the execution layer trustworthy enough for executives to act on it.

You will own the operating outputs behind those decisions: portfolio dashboards that expose slippage before it becomes a surprise, vendor scorecards tied to real contractual commitments, competitive bid packages that make trade-offs clear, and contract controls that prevent unsupported spend. AI will be part of your daily workflow, helping you standardize updates, detect anomalies, compare bids, analyze vendor performance, and validate invoices.

This is not a PMO role built around meetings, process compliance, or polished status decks. It is for an operator who wants their work to have consequences. When a vendor underperforms, your evidence should make that obvious. When spend drifts from the contract, your controls should catch it. When executives need to make a $5M decision, your outputs should give them the confidence to make it fast. If that sounds like the level of ownership you have been looking for, apply.

What You Will Be Doing

Own portfolio-level dashboards across 10+ concurrent initiatives, using AI to standardize updates, detect slippage, expose blockers, and maintain a trusted executive view of delivery, budget, and risk
Run recurring vendor performance reviews and maintain rubric-based scorecards that combine delivery, quality, cost, contractual commitments, and qualitative performance signals
Lead competitive technology-vendor procurement, including structured bid packages, normalized comparisons, scoring rubrics, SOW development, and evidence-backed recommendations
Govern contracts and invoices by tracking fee caps, milestones, acceptance criteria, and amendments, then validating invoices against signed terms before spend is approved
Use AI daily to analyze portfolio data, detect anomalies, surface underperformance, draft decision-ready outputs, and reduce manual PMO administration

What You Won’t Be Doing

Producing status reports that executives read but never use to make decisions
Running a meeting-heavy PMO where coordination matters more than measurable execution
Treating vendor management as relationship maintenance while missed commitments go unchallenged
Passing contracts, SOWs, invoices, or procurement decisions to someone else because they look too commercial or technical
Using AI as an occasional productivity trick instead of a core part of how you operate

Principal Program Manager Key Responsibilities

Produce reliable, AI-powered dashboards, scorecards, procurement packages, and contract controls that give executives the clarity and leverage to hold vendors accountable, control costs, and accelerate delivery across a $50M EdTech portfolio.

Basic Requirements

Personally owned execution across 10+ concurrent initiatives with at least $5M in portfolio budget responsibility, tracking spend and making evidence-backed recommendations on budget allocation, vendor selection, and initiative priorities. Final approval authority and P&L ownership are not required
Managed 5+ external technology vendors at the same time, such as SaaS providers, AI/ML platforms, marketing agencies, or engineering firms
Built and maintained portfolio-level dashboards covering metrics such as delivery health, budget burn versus forecast, milestone completion, and major risks or blockers
Can point to a case where C-suite leaders used your portfolio data to make a go/no-go decision on a vendor renewal, budget reallocation, or initiative deprioritization
Directly led competitive technology procurement, including structured bid evaluation, vendor scoring, negotiation, and recommendations for executive approval
Authored or co-authored SOWs with measurable deliverables, milestone payments, SLAs, acceptance criteria, or other performance-based terms
Negotiated commercial terms such as pricing, penalties, fee caps, or exit clauses and enforced those terms through invoice validation or corrective action
Strong written communication skills, with the ability to turn complex financial and operational data into concise recommendations executives can act on
Able to analyze financial and vendor-performance data quickly enough to recommend optimization, reallocation, or vendor elimination
Able to work US business hours

Nice-to-have Requirements

Experience using AI-enabled dashboards, anomaly detection, predictive alerts, or natural-language analysis in portfolio management
Experience in EdTech, technology, consulting, or another environment managing complex portfolios of external technology partners
Fluency with portfolio and delivery tools such as Linear, Jira, or similar systems

About 2 Hour Learning

Education is broken, but 2 Hour Learning is proving it doesn’t have to be. They’re tearing down the outdated one-size-fits-all model and replacing it with AI-driven personalized learning that helps kids master academics in just two hours a day.

With students consistently ranking in the top 1-2% nationally and the top 20% achieving an astonishing 6.5x growth, they’re proving that smarter learning is possible. At 2 Hour Learning, it’s talent and performance that matter.

They offer a dynamic, on-campus and remote-friendly environment where innovators, educators, and AI specialists can be a part of fixing a broken school system.

2 Hour Learning is reprogramming learning for the AI era.

Here’s How They’re Fixing It.

There is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. Hit the Apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. We look forward to meeting you!

Working with us

This is a full-time (40 hours per week), long-term position. The position is immediately available and requires entering into an independent contractor agreement with Crossover as a Contractor of Record. The compensation level for this role is $100 USD/hour, which equates to $200,000 USD/year assuming 40 hours per week and 50 weeks per year. The payment period is weekly. jobs.description:
Submission Guidelines

The screening process will be completed within the four coming weeks; Due to the large volume of applicants, we are unable to respond to application queries, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

The ICRC is committed to creating an inclusive working environment for all its employees. Inclusion is embedded in the principles and values of the Movement – as it is committed to non-discrimination, as confirmed by the principles of humanity and impartiality, and is open to all, as confirmed by the principle of unity.

We are continually taking steps to improve diversity and inclusion within the organization as well as ensure it is embedded in our programming.

We are committed to ensuring fair and equitable recruitment and promotion opportunities for all individuals and welcome all qualified candidates to apply to positions at the ICRC. Further, we are committed to achieving gender parity for our staff in management positions, as part of our institutional strategy objectives related to inclusion.

Applicants must be legally eligible to work in Lebanon.

Recruitment & Selection Process

Written Test 50% - Passing grade: 60/100 - Highest 5 graded-succeeding candidates to be considered for the interview
Interview 50%

Total average weighted score will identify the candidate selected for the position.

What We Do

Since 1863, the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) has worked to preserve human dignity and relieve suffering caused by war and armed violence.

In collaboration with our Red Cross and Red Crescent partners around the world, we do everything we can to deliver life-saving aid, reconnect families and locate missing people – helping those who need it most, regardless of who they are and what side of the front line they are on.

We engage with authorities and armed forces on all sides, often confidentially, pressing for access to detainees to improve their living conditions and urging compliance with international humanitarian law to protect non-combatants, including from digital threats.

Purpose

The purpose of this job is to plan, design, and implement electrical and electromechanical engineering projects within the scope of the ICRC’s Water & Habitat (WatHab) program in Lebanon.

S/he manages medium sized projects and ensures their successful delivery within the constraints of scope, quality, time and budget. S/he carries out needs assessments and surveys, prepares, designs, procures, implements and commissions identified projects. S/he negotiates with local authorities and stakeholders regarding project execution, supervises project implementation, and liaises with support departments to manage logistics and financial processes. S/he manages relationships with the various stakeholders involved. S/he manages project resources and ensures project reporting. S/he is based in Beirut delegation with frequent field trips around the country and report to the WatHab Operations Manager.

Accountabilities & Functional Responsibilities

Carries out field assessments focused on technical, social, and institutional aspects.
Collects and analyses all the information and data necessary to prepare comprehensive assessment reports.
Proposes projects to address evidence-based humanitarian needs and as per identified strategies.
Performs detailed calculations and prepares technical designs and documents (bill of quantities, drawings, technical specifications, etc.) for projects in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.
Facilitates the signing of project agreements.
Prepares tender and contractual documents in close collaboration with Logistics and in accordance with ICRC rules and regulations.
Supervises project implementation and ensures compliance with project documents, ICRC standards, and local building codes/standards.
Maintains an overview of project progress and benefits while ensuring effective communication of any changes in scope, timeline, or budget to his/her managers and stakeholders.
Monitors and evaluates projects as per agreed monitoring strategy independently, reports challenges and proposes proactively corrective measures.
Creates and maintains up-to-date project files in electronic databases as per institutional and departmental information management guidelines.
Maintains precise financial follow-up and ensures timely financial forecasting on project level.
Develops and maintains contacts with relevant interlocutors (e.g. EDL, water establishments, municipalities, etc.) and keeps interlocutors informed on ICRC activities.
Develops and maintains a network of local contractors, suppliers, and consultants.

Certifications / Education Required

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical and Electro-Mechanical Engineering

Professional Experience Required

A minimum 6 years of professional experience in Electricity/Energy/Electro-Mechanical Project Management and Managing consultants, contractors and administering contracts.

Desired Skills

Leadership: Proficient
Accountability : Advanced
People management : Advanced
Teamwork & Collaboration : Advanced
Representing the ICRC : Advanced
Beneficiary & Client focused : Advanced
Programming and Managing WatHab Operations : Basic
Managing WatHab Projects: Proficient
Managing Results and Quality: Proficient
Analysis, Planning and Monitoring: Proficient
Architecture & Construction: Basic
Hygiene and IPC: Basic
Water and Sanitation: Basic
Electricity and Energy: Proficient
Service Diagnosis & Programming: Proficient
WatHab Emergency Response: Basic

🔸
Budowanie i utrzymywanie relacji z klientami międzynarodowymi z pipeline’u firmy oraz z obecnymi partnerami
Negocjowanie ofert i zamykanie sprzedaży projektów z obszaru cyberbezpieczeństwa w oparciu o indywidualny target
Proaktywna komunikacja z klientami mailowo i telefonicznie

Zapewnienie płynnej komunikacji i sprawnej realizacji na każdym etapie projektu
Pełnienie roli głównego punktu kontaktu dla klientów i zespołu oraz rozwiązywanie pojawiających się problemów
Koordynacja pracy podwykonawców i członków zespołu zaangażowanych w projekty
Proponowanie inicjatyw wspierających rozwój sprzedaży

🔸 Twój profil

Doświadczenie w zarządzaniu projektami
Bardzo dobra znajomość języka angielskiego (min. C1)
Doskonałe umiejętności komunikacji w mowie i piśmie
Umiejętność pracy wielozadaniowej i równoległego prowadzenia kilku projektów
Otwartość na naukę i elastyczność w działaniu
Inicjatywa, zaangażowanie i pozytywne nastawienie

To szansa na pracę w firmie, która jest prawdziwym autorytetem w świecie cyberbezpieczeństwa. Nowy system motywacyjny wprowadzany od 2027 roku

Możliwość rozwoju w otoczeniu uznanych ekspertów ds. cyberbezpieczeństwa i dostęp do ich wiedzy

jobs.description:
Project Manager - Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

About Saudi Gold Refinery

Saudi Gold Refinery (SGR) is a Saudi mining and precious-metals company specialized in the refining of gold and precious metals, bullion production, and value-added precious-metal services. Operating within the Kingdom’s mining value chain, SGR is aligned to the Vision 2030 mining pillar and to the regulatory framework set by the Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources (MIM) and applicable Saudi and international standards. We produce responsibly sourced, traceable, and certified bullion, operate to LBMA Good Delivery and ISO-aligned quality standards, and invest in the people, processes, and controls behind every bar we produce.

Role Overview

Saudi Gold Refinery (SGR) is seeking a Project Manager in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia to lead capital infrastructure projects supporting our gold refining and bullion production operations. This role oversees the execution of brownfield expansions, laboratory upgrades, and security enhancements within a live industrial facility. The incumbent ensures all engineering works comply with SASO standards, MIM regulations, and internal HSE requirements.

The Project Manager will report directly to the Project Director and will play a key role in delivering strategic capacity improvements on time and within budget. This position requires strong commercial acumen and the ability to coordinate complex interfaces between contractors and operational teams.

Key Responsibilities

The Project Manager will execute the following key responsibilities to ensure successful project delivery.
Project Execution Planning

The role develops comprehensive project execution plans that define scope, schedule, and resource requirements for capital initiatives. This includes establishing baseline metrics for tracking progress against strategic milestones.
Budget and Cost Management

This position monitors project expenditures against approved budgets by validating contractor invoices and tracking committed costs. It ensures financial discipline through regular forecasting and variance analysis reports.
Contractor Supervision

The role manages EPC contractors and vendors by enforcing contractual obligations and performance standards. It resolves technical disputes and ensures deliverables meet SGR’s quality and safety specifications.
Regulatory Compliance

This position ensures all project activities adhere to Saudi Building Codes, SASO standards, and Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources regulations. It secures necessary permits and approvals from relevant government authorities.
HSE Integration

The role integrates health, safety, and environmental requirements into daily construction activities to protect personnel and assets. It conducts regular site audits to verify compliance with ISO 45001 and SGR safety protocols.
Stakeholder Coordination

This position facilitates communication between engineering teams, operations staff, and external consultants to align project goals. It manages expectations and resolves conflicts to maintain project momentum.
Quality Assurance

The role implements quality control procedures for civil, mechanical, and electrical works to ensure technical integrity. It reviews inspection test plans and verifies that materials meet specified standards.
Commissioning Support

This position leads the commissioning phase by coordinating functional tests and operational readiness checks. It ensures all systems are validated before handover to the maintenance and operations teams.

Qualifications

●      Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, or Industrial) from an accredited institution.
●      Minimum of 15 years of project management experience in heavy industry, mining sectors.
●      PMP certification is mandatory to demonstrate professional project management competence.
●      Proven experience managing capital projects with budgets exceeding SAR 10 million.
●      Strong knowledge of FIDIC contracts and international construction standards.
●      Proficiency in Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project for schedule management.
●      Fluency in English for technical reporting and international vendor communication.
●      Ability to work in Riyadh and travel to industrial sites within Saudi Arabia as needed.

Preferred / Nice-to-have

●      Master’s degree in Project Management or Engineering Management.
●      Experience in precious metals refining or secure vault construction projects.

Success Metrics

●      Project delivered within 5% of the approved budget baseline.
●      Zero lost-time injuries recorded during the project lifecycle.
●      Successful handover of as-built documentation to the maintenance team.
●      Positive stakeholder satisfaction scores from internal operations and HSE departments.

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Saudi Gold Refinery welcomes applications from all qualified candidates. Hiring decisions are made based on role requirements, skills, experience, and alignment with Saudization and Vision 2030 priorities.

jobs.title: Global VMI Program Manager
jobs.description:
Own and scale Lamipak's global Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) program for aseptic packaging customers. Design the VMI model, run it day to day across regions and overseas warehouses, and make sure customers' filling lines never stop for lack of packaging material while Lamipak keeps inventory, working capital and logistics cost under control.
负责面向液态食品无菌包装客户的全球供应商管理库存（VMI）项目的建立与推广。设计VMI运作模式，统筹各区域及海外仓的日常运作，确保客户灌装线不因包材短缺而停线，同时有效控制Lamipak的库存水平、营运资金和物流成本。

2.1 VMI Strategy & Governance / VMI战略与管理体系
Define the global VMI strategy, operating model and roadmap, aligned with commercial and supply chain priorities.

制定全球VMI战略、运营模式和推进路线图，与商务及供应链重点方向保持一致。
Set up standard VMI processes, SOPs, policies and templates (agreements, min/max rules, consignment terms, ownership transfer, invoicing).

建立标准化VMI流程、SOP、制度和模板（协议、最低/最高库存规则、寄售条款、所有权转移、开票规则等）。
Lead regular business reviews (monthly ops review, quarterly QBR) with customers and internal stakeholders.

主持与客户及内部相关方的定期业务回顾（月度运营会、季度QBR）。
2.2 Customer Onboarding & Implementation / 客户导入与项目实施
Assess customer suitability for VMI; build business cases including service, inventory and cost impact.

评估客户是否适合VMI，编制包含服务水平、库存及成本影响的业务方案。
Lead end-to-end onboarding of new VMI customers: scoping, agreement, data connection, stock build-up, go-live and hypercare.

全流程主导新VMI客户导入：范围界定、协议签订、数据对接、建库备货、上线及上线后保障。
Manage multiple VMI projects in parallel across regions (e.g. Russia/CIS, Middle East, Southeast Asia, Africa, Latin America).

同时管理多个区域的VMI项目（如俄罗斯/独联体、中东、东南亚、非洲、拉美等）。
2.3 Inventory & Replenishment Planning / 库存与补货计划
Own customer-level demand signals, consumption data and forecasts; translate them into replenishment and production plans.

负责客户层面的需求信号、消耗数据及预测，并转化为补货计划和生产计划。
Set and review safety stock, min/max levels and reorder points per SKU and site, balancing service level and working capital.

按SKU及仓点设定并定期复核安全库存、最低/最高库存及再订货点，平衡服务水平与资金占用。
Monitor ageing, slow-moving and obsolete stock; drive actions to reduce write-off risk, especially for customer-specific printed materials.

监控库龄、呆滞及过期库存，推动改善措施，降低报废风险，尤其是客户专属印刷包材。
2.4 Overseas Warehouse & Logistics Coordination / 海外仓与物流协同
Select, onboard and manage overseas warehouses and 3PL partners; define SLAs and audit performance.

负责海外仓及第三方物流伙伴的选择、导入与管理，制定服务协议（SLA）并进行绩效审核。
Coordinate international transport routes, lead times and freight costs with the logistics team to secure on-time replenishment.

与物流团队协同管理国际运输路线、运输时效和运费，确保按时补货。
Ensure correct customs, trade compliance and documentation for consignment and bonded stock.

确保寄售及保税库存的报关、贸易合规及单证正确无误。
2.5 Systems, Data & Performance / 系统、数据与绩效
Drive digital VMI tools: ERP/WMS integration, EDI/API data exchange with customers, inventory visibility dashboards and alerts.

推动VMI数字化工具建设：ERP/WMS集成、与客户的EDI/API数据交换、库存可视化看板和预警。
Define and report VMI KPIs; analyse root causes of gaps and lead continuous improvement.

定义并定期汇报VMI关键指标，分析差距根因，推动持续改进。
Ensure accurate stock reconciliation and consumption-based invoicing together with Finance.

与财务共同确保库存对账准确及按消耗开票准确及时。
2.6 Risk & Contingency Management / 风险与应急管理
Build contingency plans for supply, transport, customs and geopolitical disruptions (alternative routes, buffer stock, backup sites).

针对供应、运输、清关及地缘政治等风险建立应急预案（替代路线、缓冲库存、备用仓点等）。
Act as escalation point for supply risks at VMI customers; lead recovery actions and customer communication.

作为VMI客户供应风险的升级处理人，主导恢复措施及客户沟通。
2.7 People & Stakeholder Management / 团队与相关方管理
Lead, coach and develop regional VMI planners and coordinators; build VMI capability across the organisation.

领导、辅导并培养区域VMI计划员及协调员，提升组织整体VMI能力。
Act as the main supply chain partner for Sales and Key Account Managers on VMI customers.

作为销售及大客户经理在VMI客户事务上的主要供应链合作伙伴。

3.1 Education / 教育背景
Bachelor's degree or above in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, Business or related field; Master's degree preferred.

本科及以上学历，供应链管理、物流、工业工程、工商管理或相关专业；硕士优先。
Professional certification (APICS CPIM/CSCP, PMP or equivalent) is a plus.

持有APICS CPIM/CSCP、PMP等专业认证者优先。
3.2 Experience / 工作经验
8+ years in supply chain planning, inventory management or logistics, including at least 3 years running VMI, consignment or customer-collaboration programs.

8年以上供应链计划、库存管理或物流相关经验，其中至少3年VMI、寄售或客户协同项目管理经验。
Experience in manufacturing B2B industries; packaging, FMCG, food & beverage or dairy supply chains strongly preferred.

具备B2B制造业经验；包装、快消、食品饮料或乳品行业供应链背景者优先。
Proven track record managing overseas warehouses, 3PLs and international shipments across multiple countries.

有跨国管理海外仓、第三方物流及国际运输的成功经验。
Experience leading cross-functional teams and multi-site projects; people management experience preferred.

有领导跨部门团队和多地点项目的经验；有团队管理经验者优先。

The Project Delivery Manager is responsible for leading the end-to-end delivery of projects and transition initiatives, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and business priorities. Experience planning and executing network migrations or infrastructure expansions (e.g., capacity planning, asset transitions, or fiber route upgrades).

Preferred qualifications:

5 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
Knowledge of regional network providers and fiber networks.

About The Job

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

As part of this team, you will plan, design, and acquire the scalable network infrastructure to deliver the fastest, most reliable experience to users across the region and around the globe. You will connect Google's fleet of data centers, Cloud customers, and users by planning and acquiring long-haul and metro terrestrial dark fiber networks, colocation space and power, and other critical assets.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $163000 - $236000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google .

Present network plans and roadmaps for approval by all internal stakeholders that range from short-term augments to long-term region-wide strategies for Google network.
Manage the execution of approved network plans by co-ordinating with internal contributors such as network negotiators or vendor delivery managers to ensure infrastructure is delivered on-time and within allocated budget.

jobs.title: Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM)
jobs.description:
Job Type

Regular

Overview

Information Systems Security functionally manages the process to protect classified information. The Information Systems Security group’s primary function is to implement all classified security policy, procedures and security requirements as required by delegated US Government customers. The Information Systems Security Manager interprets, outlines and enforces classified security policies in accordance with government regulations. This position serves as the subject matter expert for SCI classified systems security processing within the respective RAND Washington office site. The Information Systems Security Manager is required to have excellent leadership skills and be highly self- motivated. This position reports directly to the Manager, Accreditation Services and Corporate ISSM.

Job Duties

Performs as the primary for RAND’s Washington office TS/SCI networks and includes SAP/SAR activities.

Supports the CSSO as duties relate to classified processing for maintaining secure facility accreditations and joint and co-use agreements with applicable government agencies.
Writes, coordinates, and conducts classified systems security education briefings (both SAP and SCI).
Supports the Manager, Accreditation Services in maintaining detailed records of security department functions and activities for monthly reports to RAND management with regard to classified systems; conducts investigations and provides incident reports.
Performs computer systems security activities, implementing security controls for RAND systems processing classified information including initial approval, re-approval, audits and decertification.
Performs duties as follows:

Project Management

Organizes and monitors project timelines to ensure the team achieves milestones and delivers results efficiently.

Task Coordination

Maintains continuous communication with Security management to align priorities and expectations.

Team Member Development

Provides constructive inputs and guidance to foster professional growth and development amongst team members.

Stakeholder Communication

Facilitates clear and effective communication between team members and key stakeholders to ensure alignment and collaboration.
Partners with the Intelligence Agencies and DOW community components regarding inspections, reviews, investigations, and other reportable issues.

Qualifications

In-depth knowledge of Industrial Security and the regulations associated with classified programs, NISPOM, DAAG, ICD's, JSIG and NIST 800 Series documents and applicable government security regulations. Must be familiar with Systems and accreditation processes (RMF) with varying government agencies.
Established relationships and a positive reputation with industrial and government security counterparts along with internal customers.
Have an in-depth understanding of principles and methods used in developing, establishing, and maintaining a federal government compliant program in classified security.
Thorough knowledge of information security systems (SIEM) and proper operations of classified networks.
Currently maintains a DoD 8140 (Cyber Workforce) IAM level 2 certification (CISM, CISSP or Security +).
Proficient in MS Office Applications and Cybersecurity tools.
Excellent written, verbal communication and leadership skills.

Experience

Minimum 8 years' experience in classified systems security required with a BA/BS degree.
In lieu of a BA/BS degree, at least 12 years of experience in classified systems security required.

Education

Minimum requirement of a High School Diploma or GED; BA/BS is preferred.

Location

This position will be in the RAND Washington DC (Arlington VA). This position requires an onsite office presence Monday - Friday.

Security Clearance

Must currently be eligible to hold TS/SCI for access to U.S. government classified information.

Salary Range
: $120,900 - $184,500

RAND considers a variety of factors when formulating an offer, including but not limited to, the specific role and associated responsibilities; a candidate’s work experience, education/training, skills, expertise; and internal equity. The salary range includes base pay plus RAND’s sabbatic pay (which provides additional compensation above base pay when vacation is taken). In addition, RAND provides strong benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, paid time-off and more.

Una volta ricevuto il tuo cv ci prenderemo del tempo per valutarlo attentamente. jobs.title: Operations and Project Manager
jobs.description:
Qualwebs is a software company based in Bengaluru and Indore, building web, mobile, and SaaS products for clients across the US, Europe, and beyond. We are a hands-on team that builds things from scratch, moves fast, and uses AI smartly in everything we do. We care as much about how a product looks and feels as how it works.

Read this first

This role takes over a lot of what our leadership handles day to day. Processes are still being built, clients are in different time zones, and plans change. If you want a structured, settled environment, this is not for you. If you like bringing order to moving parts, it is.

What you will do

Run projects from kickoff to delivery: scope, timelines, resources, risks, and status
Be the main point of contact for clients after the sale, handling communication, updates, and support
Coordinate design, engineering, and QA so commitments are met
Review designs and builds before they reach the client, and flag what does not look or work right
Handle client support requests and escalations quickly and calmly
Build and improve internal processes, tools, and reporting from scratch
Use AI tools to cut down manual work in planning, documentation, reporting, and client updates
Report on project health, delivery, and team utilization to leadership

What we need

3+ years in operations, project management, or delivery at an IT services or software company
Strong client communication with international clients, written and spoken
Experience in post-sales account handling and client support
Solid project coordination using Jira, ClickUp, Asana, or similar
A good eye for design: you can review a screen or a deliverable and judge whether it is right
Strong, hands-on AI skills: you use AI tools efficiently every day and follow good practices, such as clear prompts, the right tool for the task, and verifying results, rather than burning tokens on trial and error
Proven ability to work in a fast-paced environment and adapt quickly to change

Today, our team is guided by our core values – Collaborative, Responsible, Entrepreneurial, Self-Aware, Trustworthy – and our purpose to be a catalyst for shared prosperity and a better future. Job Description

Role Summary:

The Senior Associate, AI PMO is a core member of the Data & AI Program Management Office, responsible for driving the execution rigor behind Ares' Data & AI Strategy. This role owns end-to-end program management for a portfolio of AI and data initiatives — translating strategic priorities into structured delivery plans, running agile execution in JIRA, and producing polished executive and steering committee materials that communicate progress, risk, and value to senior firm leadership. The Senior Associate operates with a high degree of autonomy, partners directly with product, engineering, and platform leads, and is expected to independently own the narrative and cadence of the PMO function.

Key Responsibilities

Program & Project Management

Own end-to-end program management for a portfolio of AI/data initiatives, managing multiple workstreams, spanning the hub-and-spoke Data & AI organization, from intake and prioritization through delivery and adoption.
Establish and run governance cadences (steering committees, sprint reviews, milestone checkpoints) across the Data & AI organization and vertical stakeholders.
Manage cross-workstream dependencies, resourcing conflicts, and critical-path risks; escalate proactively with recommended mitigations.
Define and maintain program-level RAID logs, roadmaps, and capacity/resourcing views across engineering, product, and data science pods.

Agile & Technical Execution Support

Build and maintain JIRA structures (epics, initiatives, sprints, workflows) to translate strategic and executive priorities into actionable backlogs for engineering and AI product teams.
Partner with engineering leads and product managers to groom backlogs, size effort, and sequence delivery against firm priorities.
Own JIRA/Confluence hygiene and reporting standards (burndown, velocity, release tracking) across the Data & AI portfolio.

Executive Communication & Storyboarding

Independently develop executive-ready PowerPoint materials — strategy narratives, board and CEO talking points, quarterly business reviews — that translate technical progress into business impact.
Own the design and content of senior Steering Committee and governance forum decks, working directly with the vertical heads in Data & AI on messaging.
Develop clear, compelling storylines for complex, technical AI/data programs (e.g., agentic platform build-out, Databricks-on-Azure migration) tailored to executive level audiences.
Build and maintain a reusable library of PMO templates, status frameworks, and visual standards for the Data & AI organization.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Serve as the connective tissue across Data & AI Product, Engineering, Platform, Governance, and the vertically facing technology teams to ensure alignment on priorities and delivery.
Partner with Governance/Risk/Compliance stakeholders to track model and agent sign-offs, ensuring PMO reporting reflects governance status accurately.
Mentor and provide day-to-day direction to the Associate, AI PMO.

Required Qualifications

5–8 years of program/project management experience, ideally within a technology, data/AI, or financial services organization; PE or alternative asset management experience a strong plus.
Demonstrated ownership of complex, multi-workstream technical programs from strategy through delivery.
Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint with a strong track record of building executive and board-level narratives and visual storytelling.
Hands-on experience configuring and administering JIRA (epics, workflows, sprints) and Confluence for technical program execution; Agile/Scrum experience required.
Working domain knowledge of data and AI concepts (e.g., RAG, agentic architectures, model governance, data platforms) sufficient to translate technical work into business language.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; comfort presenting directly to senior leadership.
Bachelor's degree required; PMP, CSM, or equivalent certification preferred.

Preferred

Prior experience supporting a CDAO, Chief Data Officer, or enterprise AI transformation function.
Familiarity with Databricks, Azure, or similar cloud/data platforms.
Experience building PMO functions or governance processes from scratch (0-to-1 environments).
Exposure to private equity or credit investment workflows (CIM review, IC memos, deal diligence).

Tools & Systems

JIRA, Confluence, Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and SharePoint form the core toolkit; familiarity with Databricks, LangFuse, or similar AI/data platform tooling is beneficial but not required.

Reporting Relationships

Compensation

The anticipated base salary range for this position is listed below. Total compensation may also include a discretionary performance-based bonus. Note, the range takes into account a broad spectrum of qualifications, including, but not limited to, years of relevant work experience, education, and other relevant qualifications specific to the role.

$150,000 - $170,000

The firm also offers robust Benefits offerings. Ares U.S. Core Benefits include Comprehensive Medical/Rx, Dental and Vision plans; 401(k) program with company match; Flexible Savings Accounts (FSA); Healthcare Savings Accounts (HSA) with company contribution; Basic and Voluntary Life Insurance; Long-Term Disability (LTD) and Short-Term Disability (STD) insurance; Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and Commuter Benefits plan for parking and transit.

Market Intelligence Analyst

The Opportunity:

As a Business Analyst supporting the U.S. Army enterprise, you will conduct market research, business analysis, and data-driven assessments to support strategic planning, resource decisions, and initiatives across Department of War (DoW) programs.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description:
Program Manager

Diraq is building the technology needed to make utility-scale quantum computing a reality. We’re expanding into the UK and looking for a Program Manager to join us as one of our first UK hires to lead delivery of a major, multi-year quantum computing program.
This is a role for someone who is comfortable working in an environment that is still evolving. Our technical teams are delivering complex research and engineering programs, and as we grow, we need better visibility across schedules, dependencies, risks and resources.
Your role will be to bring the right level of structure to that environment. You’ll help teams plan, identify problems earlier and make better decisions, without adding unnecessary process that slows down research and development.
Adaptability is important. Our UK operation is new, some processes are still being established, and the way we work will continue to change as the team grows. You’ll need to be comfortable working with ambiguity, making progress without everything being mapped out for you, and creating practical solutions when a process does not yet exist.  You'll be as happy to lend a hand to get things done as we stand up our UK premises as you are doing your day job.  Part of being in a scale-up means you're expected to happily work outside your core job remit and pitch in where reasonably needed.
If you need established structures and a highly predictable environment to do your best work, Diraq probably won’t be the right fit.
Working arrangement will be fully remote while we establish our UK premises - likely in Cambridge.  The role will move to a hybrid arrangement once our premises is in place.
How you work matters as much as what you deliver. We expect people to work collaboratively, treat others with respect and share credit.

Skills & Experience

Experience working in a growing or changing organisation, with the adaptability to work effectively as structures, processes and priorities evolve.
Strong program controls experience, with the judgement to know what level of control is useful and when additional process will get in the way of delivery.
Experience delivering complex programs in deep technology, hardware, semiconductors, aerospace, defence or another systems-intensive environment.
Strong program planning skills across schedules, milestones, dependencies, critical paths, resources and risks.
Experience working across technical and non-technical teams, including researchers, engineers, operations teams and senior leaders.
A relevant qualification in business, engineering, science, technology, project management or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. Program or project management certification such as MSP, PgMP or PMP would be useful but is not essential.

Note:
Applicants must already have the right to work in the UK. Visa or work permit sponsorship is not available for this role.
This role involves access to technology subject to export controls in the United States, Australia and the United Kingdom. Applicants must be eligible to access it under those rules, which may depend on citizenship, residency, or obtaining a licence, permit or security clearance.

What you will do

Build and maintain an integrated view of program milestones, dependencies, critical paths, resources and delivery risks.
Establish practical program controls that improve visibility and predictability without creating unnecessary process.
Identify program risks and issues early, establish clear ownership and mitigation plans, and escalate blockers where needed.
Run regular cross-functional program reviews focused on decisions, blockers, dependencies and delivery priorities.
Work closely with technical program managers, research, engineering, systems engineering, operations and external partners.
Provide clear program reporting that helps senior leaders, funders and customers understand progress, risks and decisions required.
Help develop Diraq’s program management approach as our UK team and broader organisation grow.

Job Benefits

Opportunity to be involved in frontier technology that can change the world
See your impact as one of the foundational UK team
As we scale you will have a chance to grow your career

This role will initially be employed through an Employer of Record provider in the UK, with statutory UK employment benefits provided through that arrangement.

Запрошуємо Project Managers до команди нашого клієнта, молодої та амбітної української компанії, що працює у сфері MilTech та розробляє технологічні рішення для оборонного сектору. Компанія є резидентом Дія.City.
Компанія активно розвивається, масштабує діяльність та відкриває нові продуктові напрями. Відкриваємо декілька вакансій: шукаємо фахівців (Project Managers)
, які зможуть координувати повний цикл розробки нових продуктів: від ідеї та прототипу до тестування й запуску у виробництво.
Це можливість долучитися до розвитку сучасних оборонних технологій, працювати без зайвої бюрократії та будувати ефективні процеси разом із командою. На вас очікують швидкість у прийнятті рішень, гнучкість, відкрита культура партнерського спілкування та доступність керівництва. У команді всі на «ТИ»!
Ключові завдання та зони відповідальності:

Координація розробки та впровадження нових продуктів (R&D-проєкти): паралельне ведення кількох проєктів, контроль ключових етапів і дедлайнів, актуалізація статусів задач та інформування учасників про зміни.
Деталізація продуктових ідей від розробників та розподіл зон відповідальності між підрозділами й зовнішніми експертами.
Пошук підрядників із конструювання та виробництва, переговори, узгодження технічних завдань і договорів про співпрацю.
Опрацювання виробничих задач разом із конструкторами та інженерами: технічні характеристики, комплектація, функціональні можливості продукту.
Супровід та контроль виробництва, забезпечення виконання робіт безпосередньо «на місцях».
Координація закупівель і логістики компонентів та матеріалів: моніторинг ринку запчастин (наявність, вартість, аналоги), постановка задач закупівельнику, контроль термінів поставок.
Організація тестування та польових випробувань нових зразків: збір зворотного зв’язку, систематизація недоліків, передача розробникам і контроль їх усунення.
Організація та контроль підготовки технічної документації: ТУ, специфікації, паспорти виробів, інструкції; підтримка її відповідності актуальним версіям продуктів.
Передача актуальної інформації про продукт відділам продажів, маркетингу та іншим підрозділам.

Портрет кандидата:

Досвід роботи Project Manager від 3 років у розробці продуктів: IT, розробка програмного забезпечення (SaaS/продукти), апаратна розробка та виробництво. Досвід у MilTech буде перевагою.
Розуміння повного циклу виготовлення продукції: від прототипу та плати до польових випробувань і серії.
Досвід роботи з конструкторською та технічною документацією (кодифікація, подання технічних умов).
Досвід роботи з MS Project, Jira (або аналогами), Excel, Google Workspace; розуміння принципів проєктного планування.
Уміння структурувати інформацію, визначати пріоритети та контролювати виконання задач в умовах багатозадачності та змін.
Особистісно: проактивність, гнучкість мислення, швидкість у прийнятті рішень, ініціативність, чесність і відкритість.

You’ve built dashboards. Tracked milestones. Chased vendors. Flagged risks. But your reports hit a ceiling. You weren’t the one making the calls.

2 Hour Learning is building an AI-powered education model designed to help students achieve a full day of academic progress in just two hours. Making that model work at scale requires dozens of initiatives, technology partners, contracts, and investment decisions to move in sync. Your job is to make the execution layer trustworthy enough for executives to act on it.

You will own the operating outputs behind those decisions: portfolio dashboards that expose slippage before it becomes a surprise, vendor scorecards tied to real contractual commitments, competitive bid packages that make trade-offs clear, and contract controls that prevent unsupported spend. AI will be part of your daily workflow, helping you standardize updates, detect anomalies, compare bids, analyze vendor performance, and validate invoices.

This is not a PMO role built around meetings, process compliance, or polished status decks. It is for an operator who wants their work to have consequences. When a vendor underperforms, your evidence should make that obvious. When spend drifts from the contract, your controls should catch it. When executives need to make a $5M decision, your outputs should give them the confidence to make it fast. If that sounds like the level of ownership you have been looking for, apply.

What You Will Be Doing

Own portfolio-level dashboards across 10+ concurrent initiatives, using AI to standardize updates, detect slippage, expose blockers, and maintain a trusted executive view of delivery, budget, and risk
Run recurring vendor performance reviews and maintain rubric-based scorecards that combine delivery, quality, cost, contractual commitments, and qualitative performance signals
Lead competitive technology-vendor procurement, including structured bid packages, normalized comparisons, scoring rubrics, SOW development, and evidence-backed recommendations
Govern contracts and invoices by tracking fee caps, milestones, acceptance criteria, and amendments, then validating invoices against signed terms before spend is approved
Use AI daily to analyze portfolio data, detect anomalies, surface underperformance, draft decision-ready outputs, and reduce manual PMO administration

What You Won’t Be Doing

Producing status reports that executives read but never use to make decisions
Running a meeting-heavy PMO where coordination matters more than measurable execution
Treating vendor management as relationship maintenance while missed commitments go unchallenged
Passing contracts, SOWs, invoices, or procurement decisions to someone else because they look too commercial or technical
Using AI as an occasional productivity trick instead of a core part of how you operate

Principal Program Manager Key Responsibilities

Produce reliable, AI-powered dashboards, scorecards, procurement packages, and contract controls that give executives the clarity and leverage to hold vendors accountable, control costs, and accelerate delivery across a $50M EdTech portfolio.

Basic Requirements

Personally owned execution across 10+ concurrent initiatives with at least $5M in portfolio budget responsibility, tracking spend and making evidence-backed recommendations on budget allocation, vendor selection, and initiative priorities. Final approval authority and P&L ownership are not required
Managed 5+ external technology vendors at the same time, such as SaaS providers, AI/ML platforms, marketing agencies, or engineering firms
Built and maintained portfolio-level dashboards covering metrics such as delivery health, budget burn versus forecast, milestone completion, and major risks or blockers
Can point to a case where C-suite leaders used your portfolio data to make a go/no-go decision on a vendor renewal, budget reallocation, or initiative deprioritization
Directly led competitive technology procurement, including structured bid evaluation, vendor scoring, negotiation, and recommendations for executive approval
Authored or co-authored SOWs with measurable deliverables, milestone payments, SLAs, acceptance criteria, or other performance-based terms
Negotiated commercial terms such as pricing, penalties, fee caps, or exit clauses and enforced those terms through invoice validation or corrective action
Strong written communication skills, with the ability to turn complex financial and operational data into concise recommendations executives can act on
Able to analyze financial and vendor-performance data quickly enough to recommend optimization, reallocation, or vendor elimination
Able to work US business hours

Nice-to-have Requirements

Experience using AI-enabled dashboards, anomaly detection, predictive alerts, or natural-language analysis in portfolio management
Experience in EdTech, technology, consulting, or another environment managing complex portfolios of external technology partners
Fluency with portfolio and delivery tools such as Linear, Jira, or similar systems

About 2 Hour Learning

Education is broken, but 2 Hour Learning is proving it doesn’t have to be. They’re tearing down the outdated one-size-fits-all model and replacing it with AI-driven personalized learning that helps kids master academics in just two hours a day.

With students consistently ranking in the top 1-2% nationally and the top 20% achieving an astonishing 6.5x growth, they’re proving that smarter learning is possible. At 2 Hour Learning, it’s talent and performance that matter.

They offer a dynamic, on-campus and remote-friendly environment where innovators, educators, and AI specialists can be a part of fixing a broken school system.

2 Hour Learning is reprogramming learning for the AI era.

Here’s How They’re Fixing It.

There is so much to cover for this exciting role, and space here is limited. Hit the Apply button if you found this interesting and want to learn more. We look forward to meeting you!

The ICRC is committed to creating an inclusive working environment for all its employees. Recruitment & Selection Process

What We Do

Since 1863, the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) has worked to preserve human dignity and relieve suffering caused by war and armed violence.

In collaboration with our Red Cross and Red Crescent partners around the world, we do everything we can to deliver life-saving aid, reconnect families and locate missing people – helping those who need it most, regardless of who they are and what side of the front line they are on.

We engage with authorities and armed forces on all sides, often confidentially, pressing for access to detainees to improve their living conditions and urging compliance with international humanitarian law to protect non-combatants, including from digital threats.

Purpose

The purpose of this job is to plan, design, and implement electrical and electromechanical engineering projects within the scope of the ICRC’s Water & Habitat (WatHab) program in Lebanon.

S/he manages medium sized projects and ensures their successful delivery within the constraints of scope, quality, time and budget. S/he carries out needs assessments and surveys, prepares, designs, procures, implements and commissions identified projects. S/he negotiates with local authorities and stakeholders regarding project execution, supervises project implementation, and liaises with support departments to manage logistics and financial processes. S/he manages relationships with the various stakeholders involved. S/he manages project resources and ensures project reporting. S/he is based in Beirut delegation with frequent field trips around the country and report to the WatHab Operations Manager.

Accountabilities & Functional Responsibilities

Carries out field assessments focused on technical, social, and institutional aspects.
Collects and analyses all the information and data necessary to prepare comprehensive assessment reports.
Proposes projects to address evidence-based humanitarian needs and as per identified strategies.

Project Manager - Riyadh, Saudi Arabia

About Saudi Gold Refinery

Saudi Gold Refinery (SGR) is a Saudi mining and precious-metals company specialized in the refining of gold and precious metals, bullion production, and value-added precious-metal services. Operating within the Kingdom’s mining value chain, SGR is aligned to the Vision 2030 mining pillar and to the regulatory framework set by the Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources (MIM) and applicable Saudi and international standards. We produce responsibly sourced, traceable, and certified bullion, operate to LBMA Good Delivery and ISO-aligned quality standards, and invest in the people, processes, and controls behind every bar we produce.

Role Overview

Saudi Gold Refinery (SGR) is seeking a Project Manager in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia to lead capital infrastructure projects supporting our gold refining and bullion production operations. This role oversees the execution of brownfield expansions, laboratory upgrades, and security enhancements within a live industrial facility. The incumbent ensures all engineering works comply with SASO standards, MIM regulations, and internal HSE requirements.

The Project Manager will report directly to the Project Director and will play a key role in delivering strategic capacity improvements on time and within budget. This position requires strong commercial acumen and the ability to coordinate complex interfaces between contractors and operational teams.

Key Responsibilities

The Project Manager will execute the following key responsibilities to ensure successful project delivery.
Project Execution Planning

The role develops comprehensive project execution plans that define scope, schedule, and resource requirements for capital initiatives. This includes establishing baseline metrics for tracking progress against strategic milestones.
Budget and Cost Management

This position monitors project expenditures against approved budgets by validating contractor invoices and tracking committed costs. It ensures financial discipline through regular forecasting and variance analysis reports.
Contractor Supervision

The role manages EPC contractors and vendors by enforcing contractual obligations and performance standards. It resolves technical disputes and ensures deliverables meet SGR’s quality and safety specifications.
Regulatory Compliance

This position ensures all project activities adhere to Saudi Building Codes, SASO standards, and Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources regulations. It secures necessary permits and approvals from relevant government authorities.
HSE Integration

The role integrates health, safety, and environmental requirements into daily construction activities to protect personnel and assets. It conducts regular site audits to verify compliance with ISO 45001 and SGR safety protocols.
Stakeholder Coordination

This position facilitates communication between engineering teams, operations staff, and external consultants to align project goals. It manages expectations and resolves conflicts to maintain project momentum.
Quality Assurance

The role implements quality control procedures for civil, mechanical, and electrical works to ensure technical integrity. It reviews inspection test plans and verifies that materials meet specified standards.
Commissioning Support

This position leads the commissioning phase by coordinating functional tests and operational readiness checks. It ensures all systems are validated before handover to the maintenance and operations teams.

Qualifications

●      Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Civil, or Industrial) from an accredited institution.
●      Minimum of 15 years of project management experience in heavy industry, mining sectors.
●      PMP certification is mandatory to demonstrate professional project management competence.
●      Proven experience managing capital projects with budgets exceeding SAR 10 million.
●      Strong knowledge of FIDIC contracts and international construction standards.
●      Proficiency in Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project for schedule management.
●      Fluency in English for technical reporting and international vendor communication.
●      Ability to work in Riyadh and travel to industrial sites within Saudi Arabia as needed.

Preferred / Nice-to-have

●      Master’s degree in Project Management or Engineering Management.
●      Experience in precious metals refining or secure vault construction projects.

Success Metrics

●      Project delivered within 5% of the approved budget baseline.
●      Zero lost-time injuries recorded during the project lifecycle.
●      Successful handover of as-built documentation to the maintenance team.
●      Positive stakeholder satisfaction scores from internal operations and HSE departments.

new_jobs.title: Global VMI Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
Own and scale Lamipak's global Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) program for aseptic packaging customers. Design the VMI model, run it day to day across regions and overseas warehouses, and make sure customers' filling lines never stop for lack of packaging material while Lamipak keeps inventory, working capital and logistics cost under control.
负责面向液态食品无菌包装客户的全球供应商管理库存（VMI）项目的建立与推广。设计VMI运作模式，统筹各区域及海外仓的日常运作，确保客户灌装线不因包材短缺而停线，同时有效控制Lamipak的库存水平、营运资金和物流成本。

2.1 VMI Strategy & Governance / VMI战略与管理体系
Define the global VMI strategy, operating model and roadmap, aligned with commercial and supply chain priorities.

制定全球VMI战略、运营模式和推进路线图，与商务及供应链重点方向保持一致。
Set up standard VMI processes, SOPs, policies and templates (agreements, min/max rules, consignment terms, ownership transfer, invoicing).

建立标准化VMI流程、SOP、制度和模板（协议、最低/最高库存规则、寄售条款、所有权转移、开票规则等）。
Lead regular business reviews (monthly ops review, quarterly QBR) with customers and internal stakeholders.

主持与客户及内部相关方的定期业务回顾（月度运营会、季度QBR）。
2.2 Customer Onboarding & Implementation / 客户导入与项目实施
Assess customer suitability for VMI; build business cases including service, inventory and cost impact.

评估客户是否适合VMI，编制包含服务水平、库存及成本影响的业务方案。
Lead end-to-end onboarding of new VMI customers: scoping, agreement, data connection, stock build-up, go-live and hypercare.

全流程主导新VMI客户导入：范围界定、协议签订、数据对接、建库备货、上线及上线后保障。
Manage multiple VMI projects in parallel across regions (e.g. Russia/CIS, Middle East, Southeast Asia, Africa, Latin America).

同时管理多个区域的VMI项目（如俄罗斯/独联体、中东、东南亚、非洲、拉美等）。
2.3 Inventory & Replenishment Planning / 库存与补货计划
Own customer-level demand signals, consumption data and forecasts; translate them into replenishment and production plans.

负责客户层面的需求信号、消耗数据及预测，并转化为补货计划和生产计划。
Set and review safety stock, min/max levels and reorder points per SKU and site, balancing service level and working capital.

按SKU及仓点设定并定期复核安全库存、最低/最高库存及再订货点，平衡服务水平与资金占用。
Monitor ageing, slow-moving and obsolete stock; drive actions to reduce write-off risk, especially for customer-specific printed materials.

监控库龄、呆滞及过期库存，推动改善措施，降低报废风险，尤其是客户专属印刷包材。
2.4 Overseas Warehouse & Logistics Coordination / 海外仓与物流协同
Select, onboard and manage overseas warehouses and 3PL partners; define SLAs and audit performance.

负责海外仓及第三方物流伙伴的选择、导入与管理，制定服务协议（SLA）并进行绩效审核。
Coordinate international transport routes, lead times and freight costs with the logistics team to secure on-time replenishment.

与物流团队协同管理国际运输路线、运输时效和运费，确保按时补货。
Ensure correct customs, trade compliance and documentation for consignment and bonded stock.

确保寄售及保税库存的报关、贸易合规及单证正确无误。
2.5 Systems, Data & Performance / 系统、数据与绩效
Drive digital VMI tools: ERP/WMS integration, EDI/API data exchange with customers, inventory visibility dashboards and alerts.

推动VMI数字化工具建设：ERP/WMS集成、与客户的EDI/API数据交换、库存可视化看板和预警。
Define and report VMI KPIs; analyse root causes of gaps and lead continuous improvement.

定义并定期汇报VMI关键指标，分析差距根因，推动持续改进。
Ensure accurate stock reconciliation and consumption-based invoicing together with Finance.

与财务共同确保库存对账准确及按消耗开票准确及时。
2.6 Risk & Contingency Management / 风险与应急管理
Build contingency plans for supply, transport, customs and geopolitical disruptions (alternative routes, buffer stock, backup sites).

针对供应、运输、清关及地缘政治等风险建立应急预案（替代路线、缓冲库存、备用仓点等）。
Act as escalation point for supply risks at VMI customers; lead recovery actions and customer communication.

作为VMI客户供应风险的升级处理人，主导恢复措施及客户沟通。
2.7 People & Stakeholder Management / 团队与相关方管理
Lead, coach and develop regional VMI planners and coordinators; build VMI capability across the organisation.

领导、辅导并培养区域VMI计划员及协调员，提升组织整体VMI能力。
Act as the main supply chain partner for Sales and Key Account Managers on VMI customers.

Overview

The Project Delivery Manager is responsible for leading the end-to-end delivery of projects and transition initiatives, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and business priorities. The role drives delivery excellence through effective governance, stakeholder management, risk mitigation, and continuous improvement. This is a hands-on delivery role, requiring active involvement in project planning, execution, issue resolution, stakeholder engagement, and the achievement of key delivery milestones. The position also promotes the adoption of emerging technologies, including Artificial Intelligence (AI) and automation, to enhance project outcomes, improve operational efficiency, and support organisational transformation.

Strategic Focus 
Develop, document and embed the operation of the project portfolio management framework, practices, roles and responsibilities and ensure they are well understood across the enterprise.
Work with the MPMS Leadership team and project delivery teams to continuously improve the project delivery governance life cycle including standardised reporting and management or risk and balance of threats & opportunities across the portfolios.

Operational Management 
Leverage your knowledge and skills to develop and refine the existing project prioritisation and optimisation model and supporting business processes.
Work with finance and delivery leadership teams to improve and mature the financial planning forecasting and reporting of project investment/funding and budgeting decisions across the project governance life cycle.

Excellent written and oral communication skills with and strong ability to lead and influence stakeholders across different levels (including GM, MD level)

new_jobs.description:
The application window will be open until at least December 08, 2026. This opportunity will remain online based on business needs which may be before or after the specified date.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Addison, TX, USA; Thornton, CO, USA; New York, NY, USA; Reston, VA, USA
. Minimum qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
5 years of experience in technical program management.
Experience in network reliability or network health management for hyperscale optical networks (e.g., long-haul terrestrial dark fiber, metro networks, or carrier hotels).
Experience planning and executing network migrations or infrastructure expansions (e.g., capacity planning, asset transitions, or fiber route upgrades).

Preferred qualifications:

5 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
Knowledge of regional network providers and fiber networks.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a data-driven problem-solving approach to solve issues.

About The Job

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

As part of this team, you will plan, design, and acquire the scalable network infrastructure to deliver the fastest, most reliable experience to users across the region and around the globe. You will connect Google's fleet of data centers, Cloud customers, and users by planning and acquiring long-haul and metro terrestrial dark fiber networks, colocation space and power, and other critical assets.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $163000 - $236000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .

Collaborate with internal business and cross-functional networking technical teams to identify and define tactical initiatives necessary to meet Google's network infrastructure needs for both expansion and cost optimization.
Translate demand forecasts into regional capacity plans over time, taking into account market trends and technology changes to ensure the most optimized and cost effective network solution, translating this to asset/infrastructure requirements.
Present network plans and roadmaps for approval by all internal stakeholders that range from short-term augments to long-term region-wide strategies for Google network.
Manage the execution of approved network plans by co-ordinating with internal contributors such as network negotiators or vendor delivery managers to ensure infrastructure is delivered on-time and within allocated budget.

new_jobs.title: Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM)
new_jobs.description:
Job Type

Regular

Overview

Information Systems Security functionally manages the process to protect classified information. The Information Systems Security group’s primary function is to implement all classified security policy, procedures and security requirements as required by delegated US Government customers. The Information Systems Security Manager interprets, outlines and enforces classified security policies in accordance with government regulations. This position serves as the subject matter expert for SCI classified systems security processing within the respective RAND Washington office site. The Information Systems Security Manager is required to have excellent leadership skills and be highly self- motivated. This position reports directly to the Manager, Accreditation Services and Corporate ISSM.

Job Duties

Performs as the primary for RAND’s Washington office TS/SCI networks and includes SAP/SAR activities.

Supports the CSSO as duties relate to classified processing for maintaining secure facility accreditations and joint and co-use agreements with applicable government agencies.
Writes, coordinates, and conducts classified systems security education briefings (both SAP and SCI).
Supports the Manager, Accreditation Services in maintaining detailed records of security department functions and activities for monthly reports to RAND management with regard to classified systems; conducts investigations and provides incident reports.
Performs computer systems security activities, implementing security controls for RAND systems processing classified information including initial approval, re-approval, audits and decertification.
Performs duties as follows:

Project Management

Organizes and monitors project timelines to ensure the team achieves milestones and delivers results efficiently.

Task Coordination

Maintains continuous communication with Security management to align priorities and expectations.

Team Member Development

Provides constructive inputs and guidance to foster professional growth and development amongst team members.

Stakeholder Communication

Facilitates clear and effective communication between team members and key stakeholders to ensure alignment and collaboration.
Partners with the Intelligence Agencies and DOW community components regarding inspections, reviews, investigations, and other reportable issues.

Qualifications

In-depth knowledge of Industrial Security and the regulations associated with classified programs, NISPOM, DAAG, ICD's, JSIG and NIST 800 Series documents and applicable government security regulations. Must be familiar with Systems and accreditation processes (RMF) with varying government agencies.
Established relationships and a positive reputation with industrial and government security counterparts along with internal customers.
Have an in-depth understanding of principles and methods used in developing, establishing, and maintaining a federal government compliant program in classified security.
Thorough knowledge of information security systems (SIEM) and proper operations of classified networks.
Currently maintains a DoD 8140 (Cyber Workforce) IAM level 2 certification (CISM, CISSP or Security +).
Proficient in MS Office Applications and Cybersecurity tools.
Excellent written, verbal communication and leadership skills.

Experience

Minimum 8 years' experience in classified systems security required with a BA/BS degree.
In lieu of a BA/BS degree, at least 12 years of experience in classified systems security required.

Education

Minimum requirement of a High School Diploma or GED; BA/BS is preferred.

Location

This position will be in the RAND Washington DC (Arlington VA). This position requires an onsite office presence Monday - Friday.

Security Clearance

Must currently be eligible to hold TS/SCI for access to U.S. government classified information.

Salary Range
: $120,900 - $184,500

RAND considers a variety of factors when formulating an offer, including but not limited to, the specific role and associated responsibilities; a candidate’s work experience, education/training, skills, expertise; and internal equity. The salary range includes base pay plus RAND’s sabbatic pay (which provides additional compensation above base pay when vacation is taken). In addition, RAND provides strong benefits including health insurance coverage, life and disability insurance, savings plan, paid time-off and more.

Program & Project Management

Build and maintain a reusable library of PMO templates, status frameworks, and visual standards for the Data & AI organization.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner with Governance/Risk/Compliance stakeholders to track model and agent sign-offs, ensuring PMO reporting reflects governance status accurately.
Mentor and provide day-to-day direction to the Associate, AI PMO.

5–8 years of program/project management experience, ideally within a technology, data/AI, or financial services organization; PE or alternative asset management experience a strong plus.
Demonstrated ownership of complex, multi-workstream technical programs from strategy through delivery.
Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint with a strong track record of building executive and board-level narratives and visual storytelling.
Hands-on experience configuring and administering JIRA (epics, workflows, sprints) and Confluence for technical program execution; Agile/Scrum experience required.
Working domain knowledge of data and AI concepts (e.g., RAG, agentic architectures, model governance, data platforms) sufficient to translate technical work into business language.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; comfort presenting directly to senior leadership.

Preferred

Prior experience supporting a CDAO, Chief Data Officer, or enterprise AI transformation function.
Familiarity with Databricks, Azure, or similar cloud/data platforms.
Experience building PMO functions or governance processes from scratch (0-to-1 environments).
Exposure to private equity or credit investment workflows (CIM review, IC memos, deal diligence).

Tools & Systems

JIRA, Confluence, Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and SharePoint form the core toolkit; familiarity with Databricks, LangFuse, or similar AI/data platform tooling is beneficial but not required.

Reporting Relationships

Compensation

$150,000 - $170,000

Threat and Research Technical Project Manager

The Opportunity:

We are seeking an experienced Technical Project Manager to join our Security Operations Center (SOC) team to lead advanced threat and research functions. This role leads advanced analytics, threat hunting, cyber threat intelligence, malware analysis, and forensic support across all customer enterprise environments, including on‑prem, zero trust, and cloud environments.

The Threat and Research (T&R) Lead serves as the primary operational, analytical, and strategic coordinator for T&R functions and is the designated point of contact for escalations, reporting, inter‑team coordination, and alignment with customer cybersecurity directives. The T&R Lead will guide proactive and innovative approaches to identifying, mitigating, and investigating advanced threats targeting networks, systems, and mission spaces. The T&R Lead will support SOC consolidation, Intake, and SOC Services activities, lead proactive threat hunting activities across environments to detect advanced and emerging cyber threats, oversee the optimization of the Threat Intelligence Platform for automated ingestion, enrichment, and distribution, and lead advanced malware analysis, reverse engineering efforts, and malicious code investigations. This role requires participation in a periodic on‑call rotation and timely response to incidents as they arise.

Join us. The world can't wait.

10+ years of experience with cybersecurity in threat hunting, threat intelligence, malware analysis, digital forensics, or SOC operations
Experience leading advanced cyber threat research efforts in enterprise environments
Experience with Splunk, including complex queries, dashboards, and content development, endpoint detection platforms, including CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, or FireEye MX, packet capture analysis, and forensic tools
